keywords: AA 团队与 Vitalik 发布无需信任宣言并上链
EIL 信任最小化跨 L2 互操作
2026 将是以太坊隐私黄金年
退出使用合并队列 EIP-8080
EIP-7773 稀疏 blob 池 PFI 合并
summary: EF 账户抽象团队与 Vitalik 发布无需信任宣言并存放在链上，Vitalik 签署。yoavw 发表 EIL，基于 ERC-4337 账户实现信任最小化的跨 L2 互操作。以太坊官方账号转发 pbrody 观点：2026 将是以太坊隐私的黄金年，尤其对企业。EugeRe 研究在 EBSI 上实现隐私池。ACDC #169 讨论 FOCIL 进入 Glamsterdam。

items.note: （yoavw）08:31：rollup 带来扩容却割裂体验，EIL 让钱包通过账户直接在多条 L2 上执行，无需信任中继或桥；ethereumfndn：AA 团队与 Vitalik 发布无需信任宣言，存放于 trustlessmanifesto.eth 09:32；VitalikButerin：已签署无需信任宣言 07:23。
items.title_en: ethresear.ch: EIL, trust minimized cross-L2 interop
items.note_en: (yoavw), 08:31: rollups scaled but fragmented UX, and EIL lets wallets execute across L2s through the account without trusted relayers or bridges; ethereumfndn: the AA team and Vitalik publish the Trustless Manifesto at trustlessmanifesto.eth, 09:32; VitalikButerin: signed the Trustless Manifesto, 07:23.

keywords_en: The AA team and Vitalik publish the Trustless Manifesto onchain
2026 as the golden year of Ethereum privacy
EIP-8080 lets exits use the consolidation queue
summary_en: The EF Account Abstraction team and Vitalik published the Trustless Manifesto onchain, and Vitalik signed it. yoavw published EIL, trust minimized cross-L2 interop built on ERC-4337 accounts. The Ethereum account shared pbrody's view that 2026 will be the golden year of Ethereum privacy, especially for enterprises. EugeRe studied privacy pools on EBSI. ACDC #169 discussed FOCIL for Glamsterdam.
